timezone_and_session_notes: All DBN timestamps are nanoseconds since UNIX epoch, UTC; ts_event = matching-engine event time (docs common-fields, access 2026-10-02).

ohlcv bar timestamp semantics (docs schemas-and-data-formats/ohlcv, access 2026-10-02): ts_event is 'The inclusive start time of the bar aggregation period' — ingestion must align bars by bar-START; IBKR bar timestamps must be re-based before comparison.

CRITICAL: 'Our ohlcv-1d schema is based on UTC dates' (docs ohlcv page, access 2026-10-02) — vendor daily bars are UTC-day, NOT exchange-session-day. Session-aligned dailies must be self-aggregated from ohlcv-1m (or taken from statistics official OHLC, which is venue-session-based). ohlcv-1d lines below are requested for the UTC-day reference panel + roll-cost close gaps; session dailies come from our own aggregation.

GLBX.MDP3 covers the FULL Globex week (Sun evening open through Fri close, incl. overnight); our IBKR intraday corpus is RTH-only (useRTH=true) — overlap validation is on the RTH subset and session-boundary handling is itself a validation target (DATA_ACQUISITION_SPEC.md §5).

Statistics publish timing (docs glbx-mdp3 page, access 2026-10-02): cleared-volume and open-interest statistics normally publish on the FOLLOWING UTC date (Friday's session publishes Sunday); settlement publishes preliminary then final, 'the final message ... is the one you should use'. PIT consequence: OI for session t is observable earliest t+1 — consistent with our PIT roll cutoff (decisions use data strictly earlier than the decision session).
conventions.schema_choice_discipline: smallest depth that satisfies the need (DATA_ACQUISITION_SPEC.md §3): ohlcv-1m not trades where bars suffice; bbo-1m not mbp-1 where top-of-book at 1m suffices; trades/tbbo only on named event/roll windows; mbp-1 NOT REQUESTED in this round (reserved for surviving execution-microstructure hypotheses); mbo/mbp-10 NOT REQUESTED (no hypothesis class justifies full-book depth).

estimation_method.records: No records/day figures are published per symbol in the docs (NOT_FOUND_IN_DOCS 2026-10-02); therefore record counts are MEASURED, not estimated: get_record_count (free, metadata-only) per exact request line at Phase 0. Planning BOUNDS only: ohlcv-1m bars/contract-day <= session minutes (<= 1380 min for a 23h Globex weekday session, ASSUMED upper bound; bars without activity may not be emitted — emission policy NOT verified in docs); definition records ~ order 1-10 per contract lifecycle (ASSUMED); statistics ~ order 5-20 records/instrument/day across stat_types incl. preliminary+final settlement (ASSUMED); ohlcv-1d <= active contracts/day per root (NQ/ES ~10, CL/NG ~30, GC/SI ~20-24, 6* ~24 listed per the IBKR resolved chains in the dossiers — listing breadth on the vendor side ASSUMED equal until definitions are delivered).
estimation_method.storage: billable bytes are MEASURED with get_billable_size (free; billable UNCOMPRESSED bytes; vendor caveat: 'may not be accurate for time ranges that are not discrete multiples of 10 minutes'). Byte-exact DBN record sizes are FACT(sourced) via this cycle's DBN-ADAPTER lane (code/futbt/dbn/spec.py, layouts from the official github.com/databento/dbn reference implementation, main@2026-10-02): OhlcvMsg (ohlcv-1s/1m/1h/1d) = 56 B, TradeMsg (trades) = 48 B, Mbp1Msg (mbp-1/tbbo) = 80 B, StatMsg (statistics) = 80 B, InstrumentDefMsg (definition) = 520 B, BboMsg (bbo-1m) = 80 B; 16-byte RecordHeader included. Sparse emission CONFIRMED for OHLCV (docs ohlcv page via adapter lane's same-day verification: 'If no trade occurs within the interval, no record is printed') — so records/contract-day < session minutes, and get_record_count/billable_size, not formulae, set the real sizes. On-disk zstd-compressed DBN ASSUMED ~0.4-0.6 x billable (vendor claims 'high compression ratios' without publishing ratios — measure at pilot and re-project). Worked formula (NQ ohlcv-1m, 1y, front+1 contracts, UPPER BOUND): 252 days x 1380 bars x 2 contracts x 56 B = ~39 GB uncompressed bound; the real number comes from P0-5.
estimation_method.compute: POSTULATED trivial for L0 lines (definition/statistics/ohlcv-1d: single-pass parse + QA on a laptop). ohlcv-1m multi-year x 10 roots is the only non-trivial job (parse + sessionize + QA; minutes-scale per delivered GB, single core, ASSUMED) — re-estimated after pilot with the measured GB/s ingestion rate.

Method (docs api-reference-historical/metadata + usage-pricing pages, access 2026-10-02): cost = billable_GB (get_billable_size) x unit price (list_unit_prices, 'US dollars per gigabyte' per schema per mode). disk_and_checkpoint.disk_cap_note: INTERNAL_ASSUMPTION engineering cap for raw delivered DBN + zstd on this workstation (not a vendor number). Hard stop + owner consult if Phase-0 billable-size projections exceed it; cap revisable by owner.
disk_and_checkpoint.batch_boundaries: Every billable line is chunked into requests keyed (line_id, root, schema, calendar quarter) for EXPANSION full-range lines, or (line_id, root, schema, named window) for pilot/event windows. Chunk = the unit of request, delivery, QA and resume.
disk_and_checkpoint.resume_and_idempotency: A local completion ledger (data/request/completion_ledger.json, created at delivery time, NOT in this round) records per chunk: exact request params, batch job id, billable size reported, file list + checksums. States: SUBMITTED (job id recorded before anything is assumed delivered) -> DELIVERED (checksums verified). Resume = consult ledger; DELIVERED chunks are never re-requested; SUBMITTED-but-unverified chunks are resolved by listing batch files for the job id (enumerate what exists) instead of blind re-submission.
double_billing_hazards: Re-submitting a chunk whose delivery succeeded but whose ledger write failed — mitigated by SUBMITTED-first ledger writes + file enumeration on resume.

Overlapping windows between lines (e.g. an event window inside a full-range chunk) — mitigated by the one-owner rule: each (root, schema, quarter) is requested by exactly one line; event/roll windows that fall inside an already-delivered quarter are carved from local data, never re-bought.

Live re-requests / retries with a different time granularity (10-minute-window caveat on get_billable_size/get_record_count accuracy) — estimates re-checked per exact chunk params before each phase spend gate.
disk_and_checkpoint.concurrency: Vendor historical rate limits (docs rate-limits, access 2026-10-02): 100 concurrent connections, 100 time series req/s, 100 symbology req/s per IP. Scripts stay single-flight; bulk delivery via batch/FTP paths, not hammering streaming.
